heading: Trusted by Leading FMCG, Industrial & Retail Brands
intro: See how our high-burst corrugation engineering, precision Komori printing, and structural redesigns eliminate transit damage and elevate brand presentation.

items.quote: Paras Prints re-engineered our 5-ply export master cartons using high Bursting Factor kraft liners. Transit breakage across our nationwide logistics dropped to virtually zero, and the enhanced stack compression strength allowed us to increase warehouse pallet stacking safely.
items.name: Rajesh Kulkarni
items.role: VP Supply Chain & Logistics • Appliance & Electrical OEM

items.quote: Their Komori 6-colour UV press and computerized die-cutting elevated our retail duplex monocartons. Spot gloss UV registration is immaculate, and folding accuracy on our high-speed automated packaging lines eliminated carton jams completely.
items.name: Amit Singhania
items.role: Head of Procurement • FMCG & Personal Care Brand

items.quote: The 24-hour CAD dieline and unprinted sample box turnaround was critical for our product rollout. We tested 3 distinct flute cushion variations for our self-locking mailers within 4 days and seamlessly scaled to 150,000 units on time.
items.name: Arun Nair
items.role: Director of Operations • E-Commerce & Retail Network
